speaker: reyes
text: Navy. Thank God.
spoken: Navy... thank God.

speaker: reyes
text: I'm Reyes. Fabrication. The machines killed everyone on my line.
spoken: I'm Reyes. Fabrication. The machines... they killed EVERYONE ON MY LINE.

speaker: reyes
text: I need your commander. Now.
spoken: I need your commander. NOW.

speaker: reyes
text: Are you listening to me?

speaker: soldier
label: BREKKE
text: The situation is under control, Technician.

speaker: soldier
label: BREKKE
text: The situation is under control, Supervisor.

speaker: soldier
label: BREKKE
text: Put the weapon down.

speaker: reyes
text: Wait—

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: Put the weapon down, Technician.
note: rule: C: stop, a soldier leaves hold or first sees the player, sight ≤ 15 m, bark gate (below)

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: Put the weapon down, Supervisor.

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: There is no need for this, Technician.
note: rule: C: stop, the speaker was hit in the last 3 s, alive, bark gate

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: There is no need for this, Supervisor.

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: He felt that, Technician.
note: rule: C: stop, another soldier died ≤ 4 s ago within 20 m of the speaker, speaker has sight of the player, bark gate

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: He felt that, Supervisor.

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: You are wasting rounds, Technician.
note: rule: C: stop, player fired ≥ 15 rounds in the last 8 s with 0 hits on anything, bark gate

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: You are wasting rounds, Supervisor.

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: We can see your light, Technician.
note: rule: C: stop, player in regions.dark with the flashlight on, the speaker has sight, bark gate

speaker: soldier
label: SOLDIER
text: We can see your light, Supervisor.

speaker: kessler
text: Post 4, this is Kessler. Anyone on this channel. Anyone.
spoken: Post 4, this is Kessler... Anyone on this channel. Anyone.
note: rule: U (§4.3 timer); fx: radio (positional at mk5_radio)

speaker: kessler
text: Pick up the radio. I can see you on the camera. Pick it up.
note: rule: C: radio not taken, player within 12 m of mk5_radio **and in duty5 or ready5** (both rooms have a camera, S6); fx: radio (positional)

speaker: kessler
text: This is Commander Kessler. Who is this?
spoken: This is Commander Kessler... Who is this?

speaker: kessler
text: You're not fitted. I watched you come through the gate. You're the first in three days who isn't.
spoken: You're not fitted. I watched you come through the gate. You're the first in three days who isn't.

speaker: kessler
text: The keypad by the door is dead. I'm giving it power from here.

speaker: kessler
text: Code is four. Seven. One. Nine.
spoken: Code is... four. Seven. One. Nine.
note: rule: U (pickup; **its end = power cue**; also Q before S)

speaker: kessler
text: There's one cable to the surface. The trunk. If that thing gets up it, it's everywhere.
spoken: There's one cable to the surface. The trunk. If that thing gets up it... it's EVERYWHERE.

speaker: kessler
text: You're going to cut it. And I'm going to talk you through every metre of—
spoken: You're going to cut it. And I'm going to talk you through every metre of it.
note: rule: U; **cut** written by W9 from ASR word times (just after "of"); ST stops the handle there (fade 0.03 s); cut = ASR file time: "of" ends 4.08 s, "it" 4.08-4.32 s, file 4.38 s, lead 0.32 s

speaker: kessler
text: ...Yes. It hears every word on this channel. I can't help that. So listen anyway.
spoken: Yes... It hears every word on this channel. I can't help that. So listen anyway.

speaker: kessler
text: I've four of my people in here. Fitted. This room is shielded. Out there, they're his.
spoken: I've four of my people in here. Fitted. This room is shielded... Out there, they're his.

speaker: kessler
text: I'm not opening my door, Reyes. Use the keypad. Come aft, to the end of the spine.
note: rule: C: code not yet accepted

speaker: kessler
text: Good. Come aft, to the end of the spine. I'm not opening my door.

speaker: kessler
text: That radio was Brekke's. ...I know. Keep moving.
spoken: That radio was Brekke's... I know. Keep moving.

speaker: kessler
text: Kessler.
note: rule: U (Q, before the context line)

speaker: kessler
text: My door. The end of the spine.

speaker: kessler
text: The wheel. West gallery, above the tunnel door.

speaker: kessler
text: Tunnel door's open. South-west corner, floor level. Go.

speaker: kessler
text: Not now. Fight.
note: rule: C: Q while a hostile is awake within 25 m

speaker: kessler
text: Movement in the sub bay. Two units. And one of mine. Coming to you.
spoken: Movement in the sub bay. Two units. And one of mine... Coming to you.
note: rule: C: g5_spine spawned, player not in sub5, once; queued behind the pickup sequence (scene), dropped if a wave member is already in sight (S7)

speaker: kessler
text: Ignore it. He does that.

speaker: kessler
text: Forget the boat. It launches on an officer's palm. Mine, or my XO's.
note: rule: C: fact l5_boat (palm refused) **or** mk5_launch in view ≤ 4 m for 2 s; radio; once

speaker: kessler
text: Not with them on you. Deal with them. Then come back.
note: rule: C: in t5_cmd, phase S, not calm; cooldown 20 s

speaker: kessler
text: Stop there. On the yellow line.

speaker: kessler
text: The camera says you're clean. The cameras are his. I need to see your neck. With my own eyes.
spoken: The camera says you're clean. The cameras are his... I need to see your neck. With my OWN EYES.

speaker: kessler
text: Turn around.
note: rule: C: check pending, on the line, yaw within ±90° of +x (facing the door)

speaker: kessler
text: Stay like that.
note: rule: C: check pending, on the line, not facing the door (B3)

speaker: kessler
text: Turn around, Reyes. Please.
note: rule: C: check pending 8 s after the first line and still facing the door; cooldown 8 s

speaker: kessler
text: Where are you going? Back on the line.
note: rule: C: left t5_cmd_line with the check pending; cooldown 10 s

speaker: kessler
text: ...Clean. God. Clean.
spoken: Clean... God. Clean.

speaker: kessler
text: Risa. Ødegård. Hagen. Knutsen. They had the module watch when it happened.
spoken: Risa. Oedegaard. Hagen. Knutsen. They had the module watch when it happened.

speaker: kessler
text: In here they're still themselves. The second this door opens, they're his. So it doesn't open.
spoken: In here they're still themselves. The second this door opens, they're his. So it doesn't open.

speaker: kessler
text: Dr. Sunde's in here too. She came up on Monday to warn me. I listened. Too late for the rest.
spoken: Dr. Sunde's in here too. She came up on Monday to warn me. I listened... Too late for the rest.

speaker: kessler
text: The cable tunnel's off the sub bay. I've released it. Hydraulics are isolated at the gallery wheel, west side.

speaker: kessler
text: That door takes a torpedo. Save your rounds.
note: rule: C: a player bullet hits door5_cmd / the port, radio, once

speaker: kessler
text: That's him. Emergency lighting's hard-wired. He can't take that. Use it.
spoken: That's him. Emergency lighting's hard-wired... He can't take that. Use it.

speaker: kessler
text: Four in the launch-lock access. Two of them mine. Take the high ground if you can.

speaker: kessler
text: Tunnel door's open. Go. Don't stop for anything.
note: rule: C: phase W, l5_unit_wheel end + 0.4 s, once (S7)

speaker: kessler
text: You're in. The head-end is two hundred metres on. I'll be here.
spoken: You're in. The head-end is two hundred metres on... I'll be here.
note: rule: C: phase X, 0 hostiles in tunnel5

speaker: reyes
text: Reyes. I'm— Fabrication. I came up through Bio.
spoken: Reyes. I'm... Fabrication. I came up through Bio.

speaker: reyes
text: Then... come out here. Help me.

speaker: choir
text: We can hear you, Commander. We always could.

speaker: choir
text: Four, seven, one, nine. Thank you, Commander.
note: rule: C: code accepted ≤ 2 s ago, once

speaker: choir
text: Brekke. Solberg. Tveit. Nilsen. Lund. Vik. Holte. Myhre. Bakke.
note: rule: U (v5_bunk_radio; the vignette fades it out at 6 s); fx: radio:1 (positional at mk5_bunk_radio)
spoken: Brecka. Solberg. Tweit. Nilsen. Lund. Vik. Holta. Mira. Bacca.

speaker: choir
text: Four, Commander. We will wait for them. We are good at waiting.

speaker: choir
text: Four, Commander. We will wait. The Supervisor taught us patience.

speaker: choir
text: A fine boat, Technician. It needs only a steady hand.
spoken: A fine boat, Technician. It needs only a STEADY HAND.
note: rule: C: stop, heard nothing of Kessler in the last 4 s, after v5_sub_check (or the board in view ≥ 2 s in V), once; fx: choir (2-D PA)

speaker: choir
text: A fine boat, Supervisor. It needs only a steady hand.
spoken: A fine boat, Supervisor. It needs only a STEADY HAND.

speaker: choir
text: It is a long way to the head-end, Technician. We will keep you company.
note: rule: C: stop, phase X, after l5_kes_end

speaker: choir
text: It is a long way to the head-end, Supervisor. We will walk with you.
